news.titleEn: Current price of oil as of Sept. 8, 2026
news.conclusionEn: Brent crude neared $100 a barrel, trading around $99.85, as renewed US-Iran strikes around the Strait of Hormuz raised fears of a serious oil supply disruption.
news.conclusionZh: 布伦特原油逼近100美元，美伊在霍尔木兹海峡冲突升级。
news.whyEn: Oil near $100 feeds directly into global inflation, makes it harder for central banks to cut rates, and squeezes consumers and energy-importing economies.
news.whyZh: 油价逼近百元直接推高全球通胀，令央行更难降息，并挤压消费者和能源进口国。
news.detailEn: US and Iranian forces have traded strikes for days, with Washington hitting Revolutionary Guard targets in Iran after attempted attacks on commercial shipping and US troops, and Tehran vowing retaliation. Brent has risen roughly 50% over the past year and is now testing $100, its highest in months, while US WTI trades in the mid-$90s. Goldman Sachs recently lifted its Brent and WTI forecasts by $5 each. No major supply has actually been lost yet, but traders are pricing a growing risk premium around the Strait of Hormuz, through which about a fifth of the world's seaborne oil passes. A sustained move above $100 would complicate this week's US and euro-zone inflation readings just as the Fed and ECB weigh rate decisions.
news.detailZh: 美伊两军已连日互袭，美方在商业航运和驻军遇袭后打击了伊朗的革命卫队目标，德黑兰誓言报复。布伦特原油过去一年已上涨约50%，正试探100美元关口，创数月新高；美国WTI则在90美元中段交易。高盛近期将布伦特和WTI预测各上调5美元。目前尚无重大供应中断，但交易员正在为霍尔木兹海峡周边不断上升的风险溢价定价，全球约五分之一海运石油经此通过。若油价持续站上100美元，将令本周美国和欧元区的通胀数据、以及美联储和欧洲央行的利率决议更趋复杂。

news.titleEn: Stock Market Today (Sept. 8, 2026): Dow, S&P 500 dip as oil tests $100/bbl; 10Y nears two-decade high
news.conclusionEn: US stocks slipped on Tuesday and the 10-year Treasury yield pushed toward a two-decade high as surging oil and a strong jobs report fuelled bets on a September Fed rate hike.
news.conclusionZh: 美股周二走低，10年期美债收益率逼近二十年高位。
news.whyEn: Rising long-term yields lift borrowing costs on mortgages, corporate debt and government financing worldwide, tighten financial conditions and pressure highly valued stocks.
news.whyZh: 长端收益率走高会抬高全球房贷、企业和政府融资成本，收紧金融环境并施压高估值股票。
news.detailEn: Friday's report showed US payrolls rose well above forecasts, and fed funds futures now price around a 59% chance of a quarter-point hike at the Sept. 15-16 meeting. The 10-year yield has climbed toward levels last seen in the mid-2000s, part of a synchronised global bond sell-off that has also lifted Japanese and German yields. Energy shares gained with oil, while rate-sensitive technology and growth names lagged, though chip stocks stayed firm. Investors are focused on August producer prices due Sept. 10 and consumer prices due Sept. 11, the last major readings before the Fed meets. A hot inflation print could push yields higher still, while a soft one could bring relief.
news.detailZh: 上周五数据显示美国非农就业远超预期，联邦基金期货目前定价9月15至16日会议加息25基点的概率约为59%。10年期美债收益率已升至2000年代中期以来的水平，属于全球国债同步抛售的一部分，日债和德债收益率也随之走高。能源股随油价上涨，利率敏感的科技和成长股表现落后，但芯片股保持坚挺。投资者聚焦9月10日的8月生产者价格和9月11日的消费者价格，这是美联储会议前最后的重要数据。通胀数据偏热可能推动收益率继续上行，偏软则可能带来缓解。

news.titleEn: Fed's Waller Says September Rate Decision Hinges on August CPI
news.conclusionEn: Fed Governor Christopher Waller said the Sept. 15-16 rate decision will be heavily influenced by August CPI, due Sept. 11, and that he would consider a hike if inflation runs hot.
news.conclusionZh: 美联储沃勒称9月利率决议取决于9月11日公布的8月CPI。
news.whyEn: A Fed rate hike into a slowing economy would be unusual, would push up global borrowing costs and the dollar, and would be the Fed's first rate move in either direction this year.
news.whyZh: 在经济放缓时加息并不寻常，将推高全球融资成本和美元，也是美联储今年首次调整利率。
news.detailEn: The Fed has held rates steady for five straight meetings, but an oil-driven inflation scare, hawkish signals from Fed leadership and a blowout August jobs report have revived hike bets. Waller said he would support holding if inflation keeps easing toward 2%, but a strong reading would tilt him toward tightening. Markets treat the September meeting as close to a coin toss, with futures leaning slightly toward a hike. The Producer Price Index lands Sept. 10 and the Consumer Price Index Sept. 11. Economists expect core CPI rose about 0.2% to 0.3% on the month, a mild reacceleration.
news.detailZh: 美联储已连续五次会议按兵不动，但油价推动的通胀担忧、美联储高层的鹰派表态以及远超预期的8月非农，重新点燃了加息押注。沃勒表示，若通胀持续向2%回落他将支持不动，但数据偏强会让他倾向收紧。市场认为9月会议接近五五开，期货略微倾向加息。9月10日公布PPI，9月11日公布CPI。经济学家预计核心CPI环比上涨约0.2%至0.3%，属于温和的重新加速。

news.titleEn: China's imports in August miss estimates as exports pick up pace amid calls for rebalancing trade
news.conclusionEn: China's August exports jumped 25% year on year on strong auto and chip demand, widening the monthly trade surplus to about $119 billion, while imports rose 28.2% but missed forecasts.
news.conclusionZh: 中国8月出口同比增25%，单月贸易顺差扩大至约1190亿美元。
news.whyEn: As the world's top exporter, China's widening surplus intensifies trade friction with the US and Europe and is set to be a central issue when Xi and Trump meet later this month.
news.whyZh: 作为全球最大出口国，中国顺差扩大加剧对美欧贸易摩擦，将是本月习特会焦点。
news.detailEn: Auto exports rose about 43% and semiconductor exports surged roughly 130% as Chinese manufacturers gained share in electric vehicles and industrial automation. Shipments to Southeast Asia, Latin America and Africa grew strongly, cushioning the impact of higher US tariffs. Soft imports point to weak domestic demand and keep pressure on Beijing for more stimulus. Last year's annual surplus hit a record $1.2 trillion and 2026 is on track to exceed it. Trade is expected to dominate the planned Xi-Trump meeting in late September.
news.detailZh: 汽车出口增长约43%，半导体出口飙升约130%，中国制造商在电动车和工业自动化领域份额上升。对东南亚、拉美和非洲的出货强劲增长，缓冲了美国加征关税的冲击。进口疲弱反映内需不振，令北京面临更多刺激压力。去年全年顺差创下1.2万亿美元的纪录，2026年有望再超此数。贸易预计将主导9月下旬计划中的习特会。

news.titleEn: As Canada's retaliatory tariffs on US goods take effect, tensions soar
news.conclusionEn: Canada's tariffs of 15-50% on nearly $20 billion of US goods took effect Sept. 8, matching Washington's 50% levy on $20 billion of Canadian goods after trade talks collapsed.
news.conclusionZh: 加拿大9月8日对近200亿美元美国商品加征15%至50%关税，回击美方。
news.whyEn: The tit-for-tat escalation between two of the world's closest trading partners threatens autos, steel, agriculture and consumer prices on both sides of the border.
news.whyZh: 两大紧密贸易伙伴的对等升级，威胁汽车、钢铁、农业及两国消费者物价。
news.detailEn: The Canadian measures hit steel, appliances, agricultural equipment, dairy, machinery and consumer goods across more than 700 product lines. In response, the Trump administration banned imports of Canadian dairy, motorcycles and alcohol from Sept. 29 and told federal agencies to drop Canadian goods from government purchasing. Ottawa announced a roughly C$5.4 billion support package for affected businesses and workers, with Prime Minister Mark Carney saying Canada will match Washington dollar for dollar. The Kiel Institute estimates US importers and consumers absorb about 96% of the tariff burden. Canada is the largest buyer of US-made cars, raising concern for automakers.
news.detailZh: 加方措施覆盖钢铁、家电、农业设备、乳制品、机械和消费品等700多个品类。作为回应，特朗普政府自9月29日起禁止进口加拿大乳制品、摩托车和酒类，并要求联邦机构将加拿大商品移出政府采购清单。渥太华宣布约54亿加元的方案支持受影响的企业和工人，总理卡尼称加拿大将与华盛顿「一美元对一美元」对等回击。基尔世界经济研究所估计，美国进口商和消费者承担约96%的关税成本。加拿大是美国制造汽车的最大买家，令车企担忧。

news.titleEn: Micron Rockets 4.2% as GPT-6 Reignites the Memory Trade
news.conclusionEn: OpenAI's launch of GPT-6 Astra has poured fresh fuel on the AI hardware trade, sending Micron up about 4.2% toward $1,000 a share and lifting chip peers, with Intel up 9% and AMD up 6%.
news.conclusionZh: OpenAI发布GPT-6 Astra，重燃AI硬件行情，美光涨约4.2%逼近千元。
news.whyEn: High-bandwidth memory is now seen as the key bottleneck for AI data centres, and chip stocks have become a major driver of the overall stock market's direction.
news.whyZh: 高带宽内存被视为AI数据中心的关键瓶颈，芯片股已成为左右大盘方向的主力。
news.detailEn: OpenAI released GPT-6 Astra to broad availability on Sept. 4, touting computer-use capabilities and benchmark scores it says beat rivals including Anthropic. Investors read the launch as confirmation that demand for AI compute and memory will keep climbing, extending a rally that has lifted Micron roughly 240% in 2026 and past a $1 trillion market value. Industry-wide semiconductor revenue is projected near $1.5 trillion this year, led by high-bandwidth memory. Skeptics note valuations now price in years of flawless execution, and Micron's Sept. 30 earnings are seen as a key test. Chip strength has repeatedly offset macro headwinds such as high oil and rising yields.
news.detailZh: OpenAI于9月4日将GPT-6 Astra开放给广泛用户，宣称其「操作电脑」能力和基准得分超过包括Anthropic在内的对手。投资者将此视为AI算力和内存需求将持续攀升的确认，延续了让美光2026年上涨约240%、市值突破1万亿美元的涨势。全行业半导体收入今年预计接近1.5万亿美元，主要由高带宽内存拉动。质疑者指出，当前估值已计入多年零失误的执行，美光9月30日的财报被视为关键考验。芯片股的强势已多次抵消油价高企和收益率上行等宏观逆风。

news.titleEn: Apple announces iPhone 18 Pro and foldable iPhone Ultra event: 'Surprise and shine'
news.conclusionEn: Apple holds its 'Surprise and shine' event on Sept. 9 in Cupertino, where new CEO John Ternus is expected to unveil the iPhone 18 Pro line and Apple's first foldable, the rumoured iPhone Ultra.
news.conclusionZh: 苹果9月9日举行发布会，新任CEO预计发布iPhone 18 Pro和首款折叠屏手机。
news.whyEn: It is Apple's biggest hardware launch in years and Ternus's first keynote as CEO, and the roughly $2,100-plus foldable tests whether Apple can revive iPhone upgrade demand.
news.whyZh: 这是苹果多年来最大硬件发布，也是新CEO首秀，逾2100美元的折叠屏考验换机需求。
news.detailEn: Apple is expected to show the iPhone 18 Pro and 18 Pro Max, a book-style foldable rumoured to be called iPhone Ultra priced between about $2,099 and $2,299, and new Apple Watch Series 12 and Ultra 4 models. Reported Pro upgrades include a variable-aperture main camera, a smaller Dynamic Island and Apple's in-house C2 modem. The standard iPhone 18, 18e and an iPhone Air 2 are reportedly delayed to spring 2027, splitting Apple's annual launch for the first time. John Ternus took over from Tim Cook as CEO on Sept. 1 and will lead the presentation. The event streams from Apple Park at 10 a.m. Pacific.
news.detailZh: 苹果预计将展示iPhone 18 Pro和18 Pro Max、一款传闻名为iPhone Ultra、售价约2099至2299美元的书本式折叠屏手机，以及新款Apple Watch Series 12和Ultra 4。据报道Pro机型升级包括可变光圈主摄、更小的灵动岛和苹果自研C2基带。标准版iPhone 18、18e和iPhone Air 2据称推迟至2027年春季，苹果首次拆分年度发布节奏。约翰·特努斯于9月1日接替蒂姆·库克出任CEO，并将主持此次发布。发布会将于太平洋时间上午10点从Apple Park直播。

news.titleEn: U.K. sanctions Israeli West Bank settlements, setting up clash with U.S.
news.conclusionEn: The UK, joined by France and Canada, announced a ban on imports of goods and some services from Israeli settlements in the occupied West Bank, drawing condemnation from Israel and the US.
news.conclusionZh: 英国联合法国、加拿大宣布禁止进口以色列西岸定居点商品，招致以美谴责。
news.whyEn: It is one of the most significant Western economic moves against Israeli settlement policy in years and opens a rift between the UK and the Trump administration.
news.whyZh: 这是多年来西方针对以色列定居点政策最重大的经济举措，令英美关系出现裂痕。
news.detailEn: Foreign Secretary Ed Miliband told Parliament the UK will bar all settlement goods and services such as financing, construction and real estate, to be implemented within six to nine months. The government cited accelerated settlement building, including bidding on 1,234 homes in the contested E1 project near Jerusalem. France and Canada announced parallel measures, with several other European states backing or preparing similar bans. US Ambassador Mike Huckabee called the step discrimination and warned of possible retaliation, while Israel labelled it despicable and ordered the British consulate in Jerusalem closed. The moves deepen Israel's diplomatic isolation among traditional Western partners.
news.detailZh: 外交大臣米利班德向议会表示，英国将禁止所有定居点商品以及融资、建筑和房地产等服务，将在六至九个月内实施。政府援引定居点建设加速为由，包括对耶路撒冷附近争议性E1项目1234套住房的招标。法国和加拿大宣布了平行措施，另有多个欧洲国家支持或正准备类似禁令。美国大使赫卡比称此举是歧视并警告可能报复，以色列则斥之为「卑劣」，并下令关闭英国驻耶路撒冷领事馆。这些举措加深了以色列在传统西方伙伴中的外交孤立。

businessTips.explanationEn: Switching costs are the money, time, effort and risk a customer must absorb to move from one company's product to a competitor's. They can be financial (cancellation fees, new equipment), procedural (learning new software, migrating data) or relational (losing history, contacts or accumulated status). High switching costs lock in customers and let a business hold price and margin even when rivals are cheaper, which is why investors treat them as a durable competitive moat. The flip side: to win customers away from an incumbent, you usually have to pay down their switching cost for them.
businessTips.explanationZh: 转换成本是客户从一家公司的产品转向竞争对手时必须承担的金钱、时间、精力和风险。它可以是财务上的（违约金、更换设备）、流程上的（学习新软件、迁移数据），也可以是关系上的（失去历史记录、人脉或积累的等级权益）。高转换成本能锁定客户，让企业即使比对手贵也能守住价格和利润，因此投资者把它看作持久的竞争护城河。反过来，要从在位者手里抢客户，通常得替对方把这笔转换成本补上。
businessTips.exampleEn: A company that has run payroll on one software platform for years has staff trained on it, other systems integrated around it and five years of records inside it. A rival offering a 20% lower price still loses the deal, because migrating would cost weeks of work and risk a botched pay run. The challenger eventually wins only by offering free migration help and waiving the first three months of fees.
businessTips.exampleZh: 一家公司多年用同一套软件发工资，员工都已熟练，周边系统围绕它搭建，里面还存着五年的记录。竞争对手报价低两成仍拿不下这单，因为迁移要花数周、还可能把发薪搞砸。这家挑战者最后只能靠提供免费迁移协助、并免收前三个月费用才赢得客户。

businessTips.explanationEn: A minimum viable product is the smallest, roughest version of an idea that still lets real customers use it and shows whether they actually want it. The point is not to ship something cheap and bad, but to test your riskiest assumption with the least time and money before committing to a full build. A good MVP can be a manual service, a single landing page, a spreadsheet running behind the scenes, or one core feature done well. You keep going only if the market responds; otherwise you have saved months.
businessTips.explanationZh: 最小可行产品是一个想法最小、最粗糙但仍能让真实客户使用、并显示他们是否真的需要它的版本。重点不是随便做个又便宜又差的东西，而是在投入完整开发之前，用最少的时间和金钱去验证你风险最高的假设。一个好的MVP可以是人工提供的服务、一个落地页、背后用表格手工处理，或者把一个核心功能做好。只有当市场有回应时才继续做下去，否则你已经省下了好几个月。
businessTips.exampleEn: Someone wants to build an app that plans weekly meals around supermarket discounts. Instead of coding for six months, they spend a month emailing a hand-made plan as a PDF to 30 paying users each week, built from a spreadsheet. By the end they know the retention rate, what people complain about and what they will pay, and only then decide whether the app is worth building.
businessTips.exampleZh: 有人想做一个根据超市折扣安排每周菜谱的App。他没有先写六个月代码，而是花一个月，每周用一份表格手工做好方案，以PDF形式发给30位付费用户。到最后，他清楚了留存率、用户抱怨什么、愿意付多少钱，然后才决定这个App值不值得开发。

businessTips.explanationEn: An expense ratio is the annual percentage of your money that a fund (mutual fund or ETF) charges to cover management and operating costs. It is deducted quietly from the fund's assets, so you never receive a bill, but it lowers your return every single year. The gap between a 0.05% index fund and a 1.0% active fund sounds tiny, yet compounded over decades it can consume a large share of your final balance. For most long-term investors, keeping expense ratios low is one of the few return-boosting levers they fully control.
businessTips.explanationZh: 费用率是基金（共同基金或ETF）每年从你的资金中收取、用于支付管理和运营成本的百分比。它被悄悄从基金资产中扣除，你不会收到账单，但它每年都在拉低你的回报。0.05%的指数基金和1.0%的主动基金之间的差距听起来很小，但在几十年里复利累积，可能吞掉你最终余额中相当大的一部分。对多数长期投资者来说，把费用率压低是他们能完全掌控的、少数几个能提升回报的杠杆之一。
businessTips.exampleEn: Two investors each put $10,000 into funds returning 7% a year before fees and hold for 30 years. One pays a 0.10% expense ratio and ends with about $74,000; the other pays 1.10% and ends with about $56,000. That one-percentage-point difference in fees quietly cost roughly $18,000, with no difference in what the funds actually held.
businessTips.exampleZh: 两位投资者各拿1万美元投入年化7%（扣费前）的基金，持有30年。一位支付0.10%的费用率，最终约7.4万美元；另一位支付1.10%，最终约5.6万美元。这1个百分点的费用差距悄悄花掉了约1.8万美元，而两只基金实际持有的东西并无差别。
